title: Customer Service Terms and Conditions
intro: By accessing or using VideFace services, including but not limited to video sessions, interviews, customer interactions, or any other communication conducted through our platform, you acknowledge and expressly agree to the following terms regarding recording, data processing, artificial intelligence analysis, and platform usage.

s1.title: 1. Platform Role and Service Mediation
s1.p1: VideFace operates solely as a technology platform that facilitates communication between service providers (such as car rental companies, hotels, or other businesses) and their customers.
s1.p2: VideFace does not provide the underlying commercial services, products, or contractual agreements offered by those businesses.
s1.p3: VideFace acts only as a communication bridge between the business and the customer.
bullets: VideFace is not responsible for the accuracy, legality, completeness, or validity of any information provided by service agents during a session.
VideFace does not guarantee the correctness of statements, explanations, pricing, policies, or conditions communicated by agents.

Each service provider is fully responsible for ensuring that all information presented to customers complies with applicable laws, regulations, and local requirements in the jurisdiction where the service is provided.
Businesses using VideFace must independently verify that their agents provide accurate, lawful, and compliant information.

s2.title: 2. Responsibility of Service Providers
s2.p1: All businesses using the VideFace platform are solely responsible for:
bullets: The products and services offered to customers
The contractual terms presented during the interaction
Compliance with local, national, or international regulations
The legality of any additional services or contractual offers presented at the counter or during a session
Ensuring that their employees or agents provide accurate and lawful information
s2.p2: VideFace does not participate in, supervise, or control the commercial agreements between service providers and their customers.
